text:
Butene has three structural isomers which are alkenes.
Which statements about these isomers are correct?
1
They have the same molecular formula.
2
They have different numbers of bonds in the molecule.
3
They have a C=C bond in the structure.
A
1 and 2
B
1 and 3
C
2 only
D
3 only
subject: Chemistry
